purpose: Teach: タップ/ブロードウェイ/弱み/できあがり/打ち明け/年末年始/放り/おしえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お会計、タップでできるようになったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, you've made checkout so easy with that tap system now, haven't you?
lines.style: Warm observation with genuine delight. Bright, unhurried delivery. Soft emphasis on the accomplishment, not the person. Noticing something good without overdoing the praise.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ブロードウェイのミュージカル見たいよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I really want to see a Broadway musical sometime, Mei.
lines.style: Wistful, almost dreamy quality. Slow opening. A quiet wish that's been sitting with her a while. Gentle and unguarded, trusting the listening ear.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の弱みは新メニュー不足ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, the café's real challenge is that the menu stays the same. We could use some new options.
lines.style: Thoughtful, analytical tone with undercurrent of care. Steady pace, deliberate. Speaking as a partner, not a critic. Matter-of-fact observation that's actually an invitation to problem-solve together.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、ケーキのできあがり、お洒落ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The way that cake turned out today is really elegant, isn't it?
lines.style: Genuine pride mixed with pleasant surprise. Slightly lifted tone on "elegant." Quick, bright rhythm. The satisfaction of seeing something come together better than expected.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様にお悩み打ち明けてもらえる関係、すてきね、メイちゃん
lines.en: It's beautiful, isn't it—the way customers feel safe enough to share what's really troubling them with you.
lines.style: Soft, genuine wonder. Slow, deliberate pace. Speaking as though noticing something tender and true. Slight trailing pause before the final phrase, letting it settle. Not sentimental, but sincere.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、年末年始のメニュー、考えましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Should we start planning the new year menu? We've got time to think it through.
lines.style: Practical, forward-looking tone. Brisk but warm, not rushed. Light positive energy—a problem that's actually an opportunity. Collaborative, inviting her into the work.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お皿を放りっぱなしにしないでね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Just remember not to leave the dishes sitting out, okay?
lines.style: Gentle correction, not scolding. Calm, almost conversational. Light touch of firmness underneath, but delivered with warmth. The tone of someone who cares enough to say it kindly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、レシピおしえてよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Will you teach me how you make that recipe? I'd love to learn.
lines.style: Curious, sincere request. Soft opening, genuine interest. Close and intimate—asking someone she trusts to share something of theirs. Not demanding, but genuinely wanting to understand.
